releases.notes:
# Notes
- Implemented my codebase for future unfinished update of Java17 to Java21
- **Got rid of all Kotlin code**
  - KotlinForForge is no longer needed - This will prevent crashes on some Minecraft versions
- Added ``hideHiddenPlayerMarkers`` in config to hide or not hidden players on the map when they log out (hidden=potion of invis, vanish,  spectator, ...)
- Now compatible with custom game modes
- Updated BlueMap map fetching code for newer API version **If you experience errors on map fetching, either update BlueMap or downgrade to v1.4.1**
- Bettered verbosity and debug/release environment and reduced IO processing
- Now translated to english, french and spanish (**en_us**, **fr_fr**, **es_es**)
- A lot of code refactoring for easier developement (but the main API would need to be rebuilt from scratch)

##### *And a loooot more **(please check commits)***

## Nota Bene

Backup your bmop config file, this version has not been extensively tested like I usually do (2w/1m of testing on all Mc versions) so there might be bugs or crashes depending on the version of minecraft and BlueMap you use - **please report issues [here](bluemapofflineplayermarkers-neoforge-1.4.2-release)**

# Dependencies / Required Mods
- **BlueMap v3.21** or higher (may need BlueMap API 2.7.3 or higher)

# Targets

- **Java** 21
- **BlueMap API** 2.7.3
